entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: This is truly hideous.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: He was like a father to you, right? Um...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: You don't need to walk on eggshells[n]with me.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I admit the subject is heavy, but... I must[n]accept the truth for what it is.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I wonder if Madarame was aware that[n]his entire existence amounted to a[n]cobbled-together set of paintings.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Maybe he didn't want to understand.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: I sure as hell know how hard it can be to[n]face your own weaknesses.

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: Is this the master artist Madarame?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Indeed it is, as hard as that may be to[n]believe.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: He made an utter fool of himself for the[n]sake of tainted glory. What a pitiful man.

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: Tainted glory...

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: My mother was the same. It's frightening[n]what the pursuit of fame can do to a[n]person.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: So this is the master artist Madarame.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: He was like a father to Yusuke, and yet...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: That incident must have caused more[n]suffering than words can describe, but[n]Yusuke somehow come to terms with it.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: That's so admirable. If I were him, I[n]don't know how I would continue[n]painting after that.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: He doesn't show it, but... he's really[n]strong, isn't he?

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: Madarame...

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: As if abusing his pupils wasn't enough,[n]he plagiarized their work, too.

entries.speaker: Yoshida
entries.en: Children are the makings of our world's[n]future, and he stomped all over them.[n]Simply inexcusable.

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: Unfortunately, there's a lot more[n]corruption where this guy came from.

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: As a journalist, I know that all too well.

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: What's this, a pin-the-mustache-on-[n]the-grandpa game?

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: Maybe it's modern art. It looks ugly at[n]first glance, but there could be some[n]deeper meaning to it.

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: Hmm. Are you saying you like it, then?

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: Sorry, but no.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Pull back the curtain, and the so-called[n]master artist is nothing but a fraud.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Rather than letting him live out the last[n]few years of his pitiful life, why not put[n]him out of his misery?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: That certainly would have been the[n]straightforward answer.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: However... Not every story has a[n]simple ending.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Man, turnin' into paintings was crazy[n]enough, but then he started clonin'[n]himself...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: I know he's a Shadow and all, but still![n]It's like there's no limit to what they[n]can do.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: It was pretty surprising. I can't forget how[n]off the wall Kamoshida was, either.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: We're prying into people's raw, twisted[n]desires, after all. It's only natural they'd[n]be intense.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: This guy feasted on the futures of his[n]children... What a scumbag.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: That he was.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: If it hadn't been for all of you, I may[n]never have escaped Madarame's grasp.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Please, allow me to thank you once[n]more.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Dude, don't sweat it!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Besides, we wouldn't have made it this[n]far without you, either.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: What did I truly want from this man, in[n]the end?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Did I wish to see him fall? Did I wish for[n]him to confess his crimes? I have yet to[n]come to an answer, even now.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Do you really need one? Sometimes,[n]it's just not that easy.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Lady Ann is right. Nothing good can[n]come of forcing your feelings.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I see. That's very prudent.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Ann... Morgana... Thank you.
